title: Kogoro-san is a Good Man
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, the real Kogoro Mouri, Ran, and the police officers who appear only in procedural capacity) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old cases/ file had the culprit right (Junji Hyodo) but left the motive as 'unspecified (not stated in the available source excerpt)' -- the full transcript states it plainly: Denkawa found Hyodo's drug-courier stash and blackmailed him for half his earnings, which is why Hyodo killed him. The old file also collapsed the alibi mechanism into two generic objects and one event; the actual trick uses two electric fans, a rigged original remote, a spare universal remote, a newspaper flyer, an alarm clock, and Hyodo's own hair tie, each doing distinct mechanical work (first fan+remote fakes zapping by pointing at the TV; second fan's timer blows away the flyer blocking the remote's infrared beam, which is what makes the TV appear to switch off in response to the neighbors' complaint). The 'Kogoro-san is a good man' A-plot (Ryohei Onda impersonating Kogoro Mouri for his old teacher Takae Kiritani, mistakenly believing/claiming her granddaughter was his girlfriend) is included with its own person nodes since it is the episode's title plot and is what puts a non-detective civilian in the role of solving the case on Conan's fed answers -- it does not intersect the murder mechanism itself. case_type: murder.
